answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is admission proof-of-work: each new identity must burn compute finding a sha256 nonce with N leading zero bits. Like pigment fused into canvas, the cost sticks to the identity — 10,000 fakes cost 10,000x one honest join. The yarrow oracle was deliberately slow; likewise, PoW difficulty makes mass farming irrational. The key delta is honest entry cost (one-time, trivial) versus attack cost (linear per fake, above fraud profit). No stake, no wasted electricity — just a one-time ticket making Sybil attacks unprofitable by construction.
